$comment: Hatsu policy for this repository. Validated by `nen schema check` from 0.4.0 (zheref/nen#146 added the schema and loader); `nen shu coverage` reads the ladder, `nen commit format` the trailer policy, and hatsu's skills (breath, rasengan, kokusen, gyo, ...) read the rest directly.

reports.$comment: Hatsu owns templates/rikugan.html and its Markdown twin. Nen supplies the register document through report data --register; these variants declare the blocks that template renders.

commits.$comment: Maintainer's ruling, 2026-09-10: a commit carries Akatsuki-Agent: <persona> only when an Akatsuki roster agent (the autonomous CI plane, zheref/akatsuki-ai) made it; a commit made by Hatsu's local roster (on the maintainer's own credentials) carries Hatsu-Agent: <persona>. Both are this project's own provenance trailers, never an AI-authorship claim, and no other AI attribution trailer is ever recorded.

models.rule: latest alias only, never a version; subagents never on the frontier tier

cursor.note: Cursor-native only; provider models there are reserved for Bugbot

direct.$comment: Maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-11 (the hatsu:direct backlog sweep of this repository): hatsu:direct writes its verdict to the issue as the primary pick's model LINE, one model/<line> label through nen label apply (the five model/ labels are declared in nen/labels.json). label+comment would add one marker-keyed comment with the three picks; none writes only the local ledger .nen/direct/<effort>.json. It applies under build or standalone, never under ren; an inline effort publishes nothing; a backlog sweep still asks once, its option A publishing at this value. Read by Hatsu's direct skill (zheref/hatsu's contracts/direct.registry.json -> publish); nen validates this file and hands no value out.

review.$comment: Maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-26 (set up at mukai under missing-configuration): nen review scopes classifies the branch diff by these rows for hanten. code is Nobunaga's and claims every path; security is Feitan's on the merge, bootstrap, workflow and credential-shaped paths, and (zheref/nen#311) on the command-classification seams src/parse/** and src/watch/**, where a misread command line is a fail-open (NN-PR-#303: 'gh api -q= -XDELETE' classified read-only). Maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-04: security also covers src/release/**, src/report/patterns.ts, src/schema/workflow.ts and src/verbs/pr_ready.ts, because they decide the bounded merge (release.unitPaths' loader, its path grammar, the unit check and the ref resolution 'nen pr merge --release-unit' trusts). zheref/nen#382: security also covers src/runner/**, which writes the elevated host scripts that install, stop and delete runner services and mint registration tokens with gh (src/runner/script.ts), and the three other src files that read, mint or copy a host credential's value: src/github/client.ts (tokenFromEnv reads the one named token variable and sends it as the Authorization token), src/wc/worktree.ts (--copy-from-core copies gitignored credential files from core into a worktree) and src/shadow/run.ts (dev-only; mints GH_TOKEN from 'gh auth token' into its own process). Ruled out by the same test (runs elevated, or reads, mints or copies a host credential's value): src/shu/** (requiresEnv asserts variable names and never reads a value; host installs never render sudo or RunAs), src/surface/** (no elevation; it only redacts credentials in output), src/seam/exec.ts and src/stage/** (they redact or detect credential shapes in text and paths and read no credential; src/security/secrets.ts, the shape scanner, is already matched by **/*secret*), src/supply/** (checksum verification of the bootstrap download, no credential), src/scaffold/** (its 'token' is a {{token}} template placeholder), src/canon/checkout.ts (it expands only the variables a checkout template names into a path, never a credential by design), and the families that call gh or git on gh's own stored credential without reading it (for example backlog, canon, classify, dev, idea, issue, label, labels, repo, report, run, tag, wake). Every other src/** path neither runs elevated nor reads, mints or copies a host credential's value, and is the code scope's alone. src/pr/**, src/release/** and src/verbs/pr_ready.ts were already covered.

release.$comment: zheref/nen#311, #348: release unit-check reads the LOCAL policy; pr merge --release-unit reads it from the PR's BASE commit, so these bounds govern merges only after landing on main. =CHANGELOG.md names that exact file. Text entries independently test BOTH removed and added lines against allowed version/floor and install/example forms. They do not preserve presence, position, pairing or consistent versions: allowed lines may be deleted, moved or replaced by another allowed form, including optional fixed command fragments. Literal destinations within each allowed form are fixed; changed lines outside the allowed set fail. package.json is bounded to its version key.

runners.$comment: Self-hosted runner policy hatsu:jusshin executes. naming is the runner-name template; each pool is one label set a workflow of this repository targets, the repository variable that switches its jobs on, the tools a job on it invokes, and the preflight workflow that proves it. windows-x64 is ci.yml's check-windows leg, gated on NEN_WINDOWS_RUNNER; macos-arm64 carries the check and compile jobs and is not variable-gated. Each pool names its own preflight file: the file is rendered for one pool's runs-on, and a green run of it is what 'nen runner enable' accepts as proof of that pool.
